exercises.name: Wrist Bend
exercises.hint: Press your wrist up and hold. Relax between reps.

exercises.name: Compound Elbow Manoeuvre
exercises.hint: Forearm rotate, then hold elbow up, then hold elbow down. That is one rep. Rest after all three.

exercises.name: Elbow Stretch Bend
exercises.hint: Thumb facing up. Bend your elbow as far as you can — an assistant gently bends it further (no pain). Hold, then straighten briefly. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Thumb to Little Finger
exercises.hint: Touch your thumb to the base of your little finger and hold, then point the thumb straight up to the ceiling and hold. That is one rep.

exercises.name: Cup Hold
exercises.hint: Move your thumb away from your hand to form an "L" — like holding a cup.

exercises.name: Fist & Open
exercises.hint: Make a fist and hold, then open with straight fingers and hold. That is one rep.
